survey_design.weight_fields_interpretation: This volume is a regional synthesis of TIMSS 2019 results and includes multiple chapters with different empirical analyses; the provided text excerpt does not specify the exact analytic samples, scaling outputs, or whether complex survey weights were applied in each chapter. TIMSS uses a complex multistage sampling design (students nested in schools/classes), and analysts working with TIMSS microdata typically rely on the TIMSS-provided sampling/survey weights to obtain population-representative estimates and correct standard errors under the design. Plausible Values (PV-based achievement scaling) are standard for TIMSS achievement domains; however, the excerpt does not report the PV handling approach used in the chapters. For replication with the IEA International Database, users should follow the TIMSS 2019 technical documentation and the chapter-specific methods sections to confirm the exact weight variables and PV combining rules used.
